cards.title: Should We Move Closer to Family Before School?
cards.body: Relocating near family offers support but comes with trade-offs beyond finances. Building friendships takes time, and moving back has its own costs to consider.

cards.title: Modeling Joy for Kids After a Hard Childhood
cards.body: Parents who survived difficult childhoods can model happiness by starting with feelings, not just activities. Making room for enjoyment means making room for your authentic self.

cards.title: Breaking Music Snobbery With Your Kids
cards.body: Children can teach parents to appreciate music beyond their own generational tastes. Good tunes matter to kids even if music doesn't define them the way it did previous generations.

cards.title: What Parents Should Know About Campus Sexual Assault
cards.body: Open dialogue with children about sexual safety on campus is essential for parents. Encouraging colleges to implement violence prevention programs protects students.

cards.title: How to Support Your Child's Interest in STEM
cards.body: Parent support is critical for developing children's interests and success in STEM fields. Five accessible ways can help kids thrive in science, technology, engineering, and math.

cards.title: Youth Loneliness and Smartphone Dependency Link
cards.body: Smartphone dependency and loneliness are reshaping how young people form relationships. These changes carry potential consequences for mental health and social development.

cards.title: Teacher Relocates to Remote Island With Family
cards.body: A secondary school teacher moved to Fair Isle with her partner and two children seeking a new life. The family—including Teddy, 11, and Hetty, 6—made the leap from North Yorkshire.
